name: Ai Image Upscaling
description: Produces AI image upscaling and detail enhancement specifications for Midjourney upscale variants, DALL-E edit mode, and Stable Diffusion img2img with model-specific parameters. Use when the user asks to upscale an AI-generated image, enhance detail, increase resolution, or improve quality of an existing AI image. Do NOT use for initial image generation (use model-specific prompting skills), style transfer (use ai-image-style-transfer), or prompt debugging (use ai-image-prompt-debugging).
